data.name: Campground Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Campground Simulator 

Step into the role of a campground shop owner and transform a quiet stretch of wilderness into a thriving, cozy retreat. From stocking shelves and managing prices to helping campers find what they need, every decision shapes the atmosphere—and success—of your campground.

Experience the rhythm of daily life as time passes, weather changes, and customers come and go. Earn money, gain experience, unlock new items, and gradually expand your campground into the perfect outdoor escape. Whether it’s a calm morning restock or a busy evening rush before nightfall, there’s always something to do.

Designed with a relaxed, immersive pace, Campground Simulator blends hands-on management with cozy vibes, letting you play at your own speed while building something uniquely yours.

Light the fire. Open the shop. Welcome the campers.

Key Features

  • 🏕 Run Your Own Campground
    Manage a small outdoor shop and campground facilities in a peaceful forest setting.

  • 🛒 Stock, Price, and Sell Items
    Order supplies, place them on shelves, set your own prices, and serve customers at checkout.

  • 🌦 Dynamic Time & Weather System
    Experience changing days, nights, and weather that affect the mood and flow of the campground.

  • 📈 Progression & Unlocks
    Earn money and XP to unlock new items, upgrades, and features as your campground grows.

  • 🧍‍♂️ Living Customers
    Watch campers browse, queue up, make purchases, or leave if their needs aren’t met.

  • 🪵 Hands-On Gameplay
    Pick up boxes, stock shelves, manage inventory, and interact directly with your environment.

  • ☕ Cozy, Relaxing Atmosphere
    A calm, immersive simulator focused on comfort, creativity, and steady progression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
